PowerShell($src = "c:\\Users\\USER\\Desktop\\pagina\\src"; $zip = "c:\\Users\\USER\\Desktop\\pagina\\tres-valles-deploy.zip"; if \(Test-Path $zip\) { Remove-Item $zip -Force }; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::CreateFromDirectory\($src, $zip, [System.IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal, $false\); $z = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\($zip\); Write-Host "Verificacion \(primeras entradas\):"; $z.Entries | Select-Object -First 10 FullName, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize; $z.Dispose\(\); $info = Get-Item $zip; Write-Host \("ZIP nuevo: {0} \({1:N0} KB\)" -f $info.FullName, \($info.Length/1KB\)\))
